system.description:
Trigger: The user enters combat.

Effect: All combatants are transported into the palm of the true Shakamon's hand, isolating the combat.

The user sets a Nirvana Summon with AV of 90 and infinite duration. On Nirvana's activation, all enemies on the field lose @Tick[-2 pp] and have a fixed 100% chance to be inflicted with @Affliction[perish 8]. All creatures, excluding Shakamon, become @Affliction[stuck] indefinitely, bypassing @Trait[Ace] immunity to the condition.

Passive: The user's @Trait[psychic]-type attacks gain the @Trait[ignore-type-immunity] Trait. The Nirvana Summon may not be dispelled.
